scope: Customer discounts selection and savings UX; checkout split deferred
findings: Offer exposure is separate from selection and eligibility validation
Checkout auto-selection considers specific item/category merchant offers when no explicit selection is active; requires address and current quote
Platform benefits are manually selected or carried as PendingOffer from use action; not universally automatically selected
Merchant selection clears platform coupon and delivery benefit; benefit sheet clears prior selections; promo path supports explicitly permitted platform goods plus delivery benefit
Basket point invoice carries pending merchant discount; saved-address basket request omits selected discount and platform benefit identifiers
Menu crossed-out prices are server-projected offer previews, not an additional independent discount
No cart savings celebration flow found; success mostly uses messages in checkout
rules: One merchant goods discount or platform goods coupon/benefit; no arbitrary stacking
Two platform goods/delivery benefits require explicit permission from both
Delivery agreement/base price is distinct from promotional benefit
Reserve usage at confirmation; do not consume on preview
proposed: Unified eligible offer selection and savings model shared by cart and checkout
Server evaluates eligible combinations and best customer total; preserve explicit user choice
Automatic mode configurable in central platform; explicit-entry coupon stays explicit unless campaign authorizes auto application
Show goods subtotal, delivery, service, named savings and net payable from one validated invoice
Celebrate only confirmed positive savings once per applied selection, honor reduced motion, no fake entitlement
Explain unavailable offers with unmet minimum and remaining amount
After discount work split checkout into contact/address then invoice/payment; text-only directions must not trigger pricing calls
limitations: Code and automated tests audited; no new customer order or production financial changes; live deployed campaign eligibility not individually exercised

current: Guest phone sign-in gate preserving basket
Address editor or address summary; neighborhood and landmark required
Recipient disclosure; account data prefilled and readonly name/verified phone
checkoutAudit.recommended: Delivery information step shown only when incomplete or requested for edit, then compact payment screen; retain one authoritative commercial review and pending-order recovery
requirements: Preserve basket, point, identity, selected offer and tip across steps/back navigation
No order creation or benefit usage reservation when completing delivery information
Pricing tied to point/cart/offer, not typing directions
Resolve whether existing confirmation sheet becomes payment confirmation or remains only for changed invoice; avoid duplicate routine review
Preserve suggestions on existing cart screen
checkoutAudit.implementation: Deferred until discount selection is unified; user currently requested inspection
